notes: Non-runtime art plan. Do not import into RIVAL_POSTERS until every referenced image exists and passes QC.

additions.concept: Season 1: Black woman coastal-defence captain Maya Okafor in practical navy-and-orange rescue armour on a storm-lashed breakwater as a colossal bioluminescent sea kaiju rises behind an evacuation fleet; helicopters, spray and searchlights, low-angle heroic scale.

Season 2: the same Maya Okafor, recognisable short natural curls and orange rescue armour, leaping from a tilt-rotor aircraft above a neon coastal skyline while a winged kaiju coils between towers; daylight-to-dusk cyan and orange palette.

Movie/finale: older battle-worn Maya Okafor and a mixed rescue squad stand on a flooded suspension bridge facing three distant kaiju during a red storm sunset; damaged armour, evacuation lights, vast cinematic scale, desperate survival mood.

Season 1: Thai teenage boy Niran in a worn red varsity jacket sprints beside his huge feathered fire-lizard companion through a volcanic canyon, both charging toward an unseen rival; dust, sparks and martial-adventure energy.

Season 2: the same Niran and red feathered fire-lizard enter a packed circular monster-sport arena opposite a rival girl and blue horned beast; banners without writing, dramatic stadium lights, competitive rather than violent.

Movie/spin-off: Niran, now older with longer tied-back hair, rides beside his red feathered companion across a glowing fantasy salt flat toward a floating mountain sanctuary; warm sunrise, heroic journey composition.

Adult Arab woman spear fighter in layered indigo desert travel clothes leaps from a sandstone arch above a caravan ambush; sun blazing through dust, date palms and wind towers in the distance, athletic martial action.

Lean Middle Eastern male rooftop runner and a female detective race across fabric awnings through a crowded lantern bazaar at blue hour while masked thieves escape below; parkour crime chase, brass and cobalt palette.

Four shinobi of varied ages descend diagonally through a moonlit cedar forest in practical layered dark cloth, grappling lines and smoke; central Japanese woman leader drawing a short blade, crisp action geometry.
Scarred older East Asian shinobi faces a towering spectral fox under a blood-red moon on tiled rooftops; paper charms spiral in the wind, stealth tension and supernatural scale.

Mixed-gender heist crew in sleek streetwear bursts from a neon data-vault corridor carrying a transparent evidence case while security drones close in; cyber crime thriller, diagonal action, electric teal against black.

Dark-skinned woman sky-pirate captain in crimson desert leathers swings from a rope between two sail-powered airships above ochre canyon cities; swashbuckling pirate spectacle with Arabian-inspired architecture.

Teenage brother and sister stand back-to-back on a commuter-train roof while a colossal translucent guardian beast towers between skyscrapers at sunset; supernatural kaiju spectacle with balanced emotional and action appeal.

Muscular South Asian woman vampire hunter in a long charcoal coat drives a silver staff into cathedral steps as red-eyed vampires pour from shattered doors; rain, crimson backlight, martial horror action without gore.

Weary middle-aged commander with grey curls leads battered infantry through a ruined black-stone fortress beneath enormous broken statues; ash snow and one burning orange banner, grimdark military epic.

Two rival chefs, a young Japanese man and an older Black woman, face off across blazing open wok stations in a packed culinary arena; vegetables and flames frozen like combat effects, playful high-energy cooking duel.

Season 1: Japanese-Brazilian engineer Rei Sato in a white technical flight suit stands inside a glass command deck while a precisely rendered armoured kaiju moves through a rain-soaked smart city; cyan diagnostic light, intricate infrastructure.

Season 2: the same Rei Sato, recognisable copper undercut and white flight suit, directs autonomous defence craft around the armoured kaiju above a coastal launch complex; pristine mechanical detail and controlled composition.

Movie: Rei Sato floats in an orbital observation bay as the same armoured kaiju clings to a damaged space elevator far outside; Earth curve, immaculate engineering detail, quiet awe rather than chaos.

Season 1: older Chilean radio astronomer Dr. Lucía Vega and a young astronaut study a perfectly circular impossible signal appearing above a lunar array; clinical white hardware, black void, subtle violet anomaly.

Season 2: Dr. Lucía Vega, silver braid and amber glasses, surrounded by layered holographic waveforms in an immaculate server observatory as the signal forms an eye-like geometry without literal eyes; technical dread.

Movie: the same Lucía walks alone through a silent polar radio dish field at night, aurora interrupted by impossible geometric darkness; reflective mystery, tiny human figure against precise machinery.

Black male forensic analyst in a tailored charcoal coat reconstructs a crime scene using translucent volumetric evidence layers in a spotless metro station; cool white and magenta neon, meticulous detective technology.
East Asian woman detective in her forties examines a single physical red thread pinned across a wall of precise digital evidence inside a glass high-rise office at dawn; restrained noir mystery.

Young mixed-ethnicity motorcycle courier skids beneath autonomous police drones through a rain-slick elevated city, encrypted data case strapped to the bike; crisp motion and detailed vehicle engineering.

Wheelchair-using teen scientist with braided hair calibrates a small robotic dragon companion inside a luminous biotech lab while larger companion creatures rest in transparent habitat bays; affectionate technical monster-taming mood.

Ancient weathered knight-mecha with exposed repair seams kneels in a flooded ruined cathedral hangar while a lone mechanic approaches with a work light; grimdark atmosphere rendered with obsessive machine detail.

North African woman engineer in cream utility robes repairs a brass solar drone on a rooftop above a dense desert smart-city of wind towers, solar sails and geometric courtyards; precise warm technology aesthetic.

Elegant adult vampire doctor with dark skin and silver locs stands in a sterile night clinic beside a glowing synthetic-blood apparatus; red glass tubing, cool surgical light, restrained futuristic gothic mood.

Modern shinobi reconnaissance specialist crouches on a quiet high-rise maintenance gantry surrounded by palm-sized stealth drones; matte fabric, rain beads and microscopic mechanical detail, blue-black palette.
Middle-aged Korean woman chef in a clean navy apron plates an intricate dish in a precision automated kitchen while robotic arms prepare ingredients behind her; food science meets warm craftsmanship.

Arab male astronaut in a sand-coloured pressure suit walks through an orbital greenhouse inspired by courtyard architecture, with date palms under glass and Earth beyond; polished space engineering and cultural design fusion.

Season 1: Ethiopian nonbinary astronomer Hana, shaved head and oversized off-white coat, stands in a field of black flowers that bloom into impossible star patterns beneath a pale daylight sky; asymmetric negative space, cobalt accent.

Season 2: the same Hana, shaved head and off-white coat, reflected dozens of times in shallow water while one reflection looks upward at a violet void instead of the sky; surreal psychological horror, sparse composition.
Movie: older Hana in torn expedition gear crosses a white salt desert where enormous black flower silhouettes hang upside-down in the sky; tiny survival figure, harsh sun, single cobalt scarf accent.

Season 1: Korean woman violinist vampire Seo-yeon in a burgundy concert suit faces a tall antique mirror that reflects an empty rehearsal room instead of her; angular framing, cream walls and one deep red accent.

Season 2: Seo-yeon, same blunt black bob and burgundy suit, plays violin on an abandoned subway platform as translucent commuters from another era gather around her; eerie elegance, graphic negative space.

Movie: Seo-yeon in a torn burgundy coat stands before a wall of shattered mirrors, each shard showing a different moonlit city; abstract crimson-black composition, threatening but non-gory vampire horror.

Androgynous young monarch with brown skin sits sideways on a cracked stone throne in an enormous empty hall while their shadow wears a crown twice the size; ash-grey fantasy with a single toxic green accent.
Older woman in severe black mourning dress walks through a forest of rusted ceremonial swords planted like trees, pale moths clustering around her veil; grimdark gothic unease, almost monochrome.
Teen boy with prosthetic lower leg drags a battered supply sled across a frozen battlefield beneath floating fortress fragments; stark white snow, charcoal armour scraps, tiny orange survival flare.

Masked stage magician and exhausted woman detective occupy opposite halves of an asymmetric theatre poster, with evidence photographs replaced by blank white rectangles and red string-like light; surreal crime mystery.

A sleeping child in a modest apartment fills the foreground while beyond the window a colossal translucent whale-shaped kaiju swims vertically through the night sky among impossible stars; quiet cosmic dread.
Elderly Indigenous woman in a mustard raincoat feeds a tiny many-eyed spirit creature at a rural bus stop while larger friendly silhouettes wait in the fog; strange, tender monster companionship.
Young Arab calligrapher sits in an empty tiled courtyard as blue smoke-like djinn forms emerge from spilled ink without forming letters; geometric shadows, surreal cobalt and sand palette.

Female shinobi in loose charcoal robes appears only as fragments between giant sheets of rain and black ink-like shadows, one visible amber eye, abstract city rooftops, experimental mystery composition.

Cheerful elderly chef serves a beautiful midnight banquet in an otherwise empty fluorescent cafeteria while impossibly long shadows of diners occupy every chair; unsettling cooking horror without gore.
Deadpan office worker in a beige suit waits calmly at a photocopier while a tiny thunder god, floating umbrella and ghost cat cause escalating chaos around him; graphic absurdist supernatural comedy.

Season 1: Indian-Japanese art conservator Asha Mori in a forest-green coat restores a portrait by lamplight while an elegant male vampire waits quietly in the museum doorway; mature romantic tension, warm naturalistic shadows.
Season 2: the same Asha Mori, long dark braid and green coat, explores a rain-dark ancestral house with the vampire beside her, both reflected differently in a tall window; prestige mystery framing.
Movie: Asha and the vampire stand far apart in a vast ancient temple archive beneath faded celestial murals, sunrise entering through broken stone; tragic mythic scale, restrained emotion.

Season 1: middle-aged Japanese woman detective Emi Kuroda in a tan trench coat sits alone in a nearly empty station café studying a small evidence envelope; rainy window, muted blue-grey prestige noir.
Season 2: Emi Kuroda and a weary male journalist shelter under one umbrella outside a courthouse at dusk, neither quite meeting the other's eyes; crime-drama tension with restrained adult romance.
Movie/epilogue: older Emi Kuroda cooks breakfast alone in a small sunlit apartment while a closed case file rests on a chair; quiet aftermath of a crime saga, intimate slice-of-life framing.

Young Arab architect and older female ceramicist share tea in a shaded courtyard under flowering vines, intricate tilework and soft desert afternoon light; gentle mature romance, elegant cultural detail.
North African teenage girl in a cream school coat follows a line of extinguished lanterns through an old medina before dawn, distant figure at a corner, atmospheric mystery with indigo shadows.

Three generations of a Vietnamese family prepare dumplings around a worn wooden kitchen table, grandmother guiding a child while rain falls outside; food close-ups, warm domestic slice-of-life emotion.
Two adult chefs in their thirties close a tiny restaurant after service, standing amid stacked chairs and steam from one final shared bowl; quiet romantic film-poster composition, amber night light.

Soft-spoken Black teenage girl tends a community garden with several small plant-like companion monsters helping carry watering cans; neighbours in background, spring light, grounded wholesome monster-taming.

Widowed noblewoman in her fifties wearing weathered charcoal riding clothes stands beside an equally weathered female knight on a ruined castle terrace; no embrace, just shared grief and loyalty under winter light.
Elderly astronomer and granddaughter sit inside a wooden mountain observatory as every star outside appears to have vanished except one impossible pale ring; quiet emotional cosmic mystery.

Young woman courier in understated historical shinobi travel clothes reads a private letter beside a river ferry at dawn while another shinobi waits across the water; subdued longing and espionage atmosphere.
Family of four repairs their small seaside shop after a kaiju evacuation; enormous harmless creature silhouette recedes into morning fog offshore, focus on human aftermath and resilience.
Five mismatched adult flatmates squeeze into a tiny apartment kitchen during a power cut, lit by phones and candles as dinner goes wrong; naturalistic ensemble comedy with expressive faces.

Season 1: Filipino office worker Marco in rolled-up shirt sleeves tumbles through a glowing portal still clutching a takeaway coffee, landing before baffled fantasy villagers and a tiny dragon; bright broad isekai comedy.

Season 2: the same Marco, recognisable glasses and rolled sleeves now under mismatched fantasy armour, leads a cheerful adventuring party across a floating bridge with a tiny dragon on his shoulder; colourful quest energy.
Movie/spin-off: Marco at a lantern festival in the fantasy capital awkwardly dances with a confident woman mage while their friends laugh behind them; bright romantic isekai ensemble poster.
Season 1: Black preteen girl Zara in a yellow raincoat struggles to walk six mischievous pocket-sized companion monsters on tangled leads through a busy neighbourhood; sunny visual comedy.
Season 2: Zara, same yellow raincoat tied around her waist, cheers as her round blue companion monster races an obstacle course in a packed junior league arena; friendly monster sport.
Movie: Zara and the same six small monsters nap in a messy living room after an adventure, afternoon sunlight and snack wrappers everywhere; cosy character-led monster-taming epilogue.
Exhausted young temp worker in office lanyard runs a fantasy dungeon cafeteria, flipping giant omelettes for orcs, elves and slimes; bright ensemble comedy, food front and centre.
University student in modern hiking gear wakes in a hostile floating-island world and improvises a shelter with two strangers as huge harmless-looking beasts circle below; colourful survival isekai.
Fashion student transported to a fantasy kingdom kneels to befriend a fluffy horned creature while astonished knights watch; playful pastel isekai monster-taming key art.
Chaotic multicultural restaurant brigade of six cooks tries to plate one enormous banquet at once, pans flying and one chef calmly tasting sauce in the centre; bright high-readability cooking comedy.
Three incompetent amateur thieves in badly coordinated smart clothes hide behind the same tiny parked car while an older policewoman watches them from across the street, unimpressed; caper comedy.
Sleepy vampire roommate in pyjamas shields himself from morning sun with a pizza box while his energetic human flatmate opens every curtain; modern apartment comedy with red-black accents.

Cheerful young delivery rider on a tiny scooter overloaded with parcels races through a sunlit desert-city market while a pet falcon steals one package; broad action comedy, turquoise and saffron palette.
Teen convenience-store clerk looks bored behind the counter while a friendly baby kaiju peers through the glass storefront and customers casually queue around its tail; deadpan bright comedy.

Ordinary salaryman in a cheap suit stands with clipboard among enormous grimdark knights preparing for battle, trying to enforce workplace safety rules; ridiculous scale contrast and smoky fantasy backdrop.

Class of teenage shinobi attempts a stealth exercise in a school corridor while one student has obviously fallen through the ceiling; bright expressive ensemble, practical ninja uniforms and slapstick timing.

Season 1: Moroccan-Japanese singer Leila in a jewel-blue performance dress steps through a glowing backstage doorway onto a fantasy amphitheatre filled with winged and horned audiences; luminous isekai concert spectacle.
Season 2: the same Leila, recognisable long dark curls and jewel-blue costume, performs as ribbons of harmless magic form constellations over a floating fantasy stage; elegant magical performance.
Movie: Leila in a simpler blue travel coat meets a fantasy prince-musician on an empty stage after the crowd has gone, moonlit instruments and soft lantern glow; restrained romantic finale.

Season 1: glamorous vampire idol trio of diverse women performs beneath a giant artificial moon, lead singer with silver bob and wine-red suit, elegant audience silhouettes and premium concert lighting.
Season 2: same vampire trio and silver-bob lead singer on a mirrored stage as moon-shaped magical light sigils orbit them; midnight navy, pearl and red palette, graceful transformation energy.
Movie: silver-bob vampire lead singer sits backstage in formal red suit beside her human songwriter, hands almost touching beside an unplugged microphone, dawn light beginning at the window.

Four young performers dance with distinct companion monsters integrated into choreography: ribbon fox, drum lizard, glowing bird and round bear; joyful arena stage, clear silhouettes and premium sparkle.
Preteen magical performer in lavender costume bonds with a crescent-shaped cat companion on a small theatre stage as soft light petals swirl around them; cute but polished, not chibi.
Boy-band rehearsal derailed by oversized playful companion monsters stealing props and instruments, performers laughing rather than posing; colourful backstage comedy with strong character variety.

Adult Arab woman singer in a modern emerald stage outfit inspired by flowing geometric textiles performs on an open-air rooftop stage above a lantern-lit desert city; elegant dance pose, gold and green glow.

Young male and female magical performers stand on opposite balconies of a moonlit courtyard, streams of blue-gold light joining between them over a fountain; graceful Arabian-inspired fantasy performance.

Three café-idol performers in tasteful pastel aprons finish decorating elaborate desserts before an evening mini-concert, kitchen and stage visible in one bright composition; food and performance equally readable.
Elegant mature diva in black sequined suit leaves a theatre through a rain-lit alley while a young woman private investigator watches from a taxi; glamorous crime drama with magenta reflections.

Solo singer performs to an empty planetarium where the projected stars begin forming one vast impossible spiral behind her; she remains poised under a single spotlight, beautiful and unsettling cosmic concert image.
Magical performance duo on a city rooftop raises luminous ribbons that calm a towering moth-like kaiju rather than fight it; dawn skyline, rose and cyan light, heroic compassionate spectacle.

Adult ballet star in black-and-silver stage costume dances alone in a ruined royal theatre while armoured figures watch silently from broken balconies; ash drifting through spotlight, elegant grimdark performance.
